title: Environmental Sciences
description: The earth as an ecosystem composed of biological, chemical, and physical systems and how these systems interact with one another and the human population.

title: Energy and the Environment
description: Fundamental physical concepts underlying energy, its conversion, and impact on the environment on local to global scales.

title: Climate Change Solutions
description: Exploration of the causes and impacts of the climate crisis and possible solutions. To include the basics of climate science, examination of climate justice issues, and opportunities to take climate action in local communities.

title: Academic and Professional Development in the Earth and Environmental Sciences I
description: Exploration and discussion of the nature of science, ethics, civics, artificial intelligence, and other topics. Reflection on and planning for academic and professional development as a scientist within the broader and increasingly complex world.
notes: Taken in fall of junior year

title: Water, Climate and Power in the US Southwest
description: Physical principles controlling climate and water resources within the US Southwest. Examine history and politics of water development in California and the greater Colorado River Basin; role of modern environmental policy in solving the current water resource crisis.

title: Academic and Professional Development in the Earth and Environmental Sciences II
description: Applications, activities, and reflections designed to promote academic and professional development in the earth and environmental sciences.
notes: Taken in fall of senior year

title: Internship in Earth and Environmental Sciences
description: Internship with approved private companies, nonprofit organizations, and government agencies. Deliverables co-developed among student, external supervisor, and instructor. Internship report and periodic conferences required. Three units required if being used to fulfill degree requirement.

title: Selected Topics in Environmental Science
description: Selected topics in environmental and related sciences.

title: Senior Seminar in Environmental Sciences
description: Research projects related to an environmental issue in the San Diego and California region.

title: Senior Seminar in Environmental Sciences
description: Research projects related to an environmental issue in the San Diego and California region.

title: Special Study
description: Individual study in the area of environmental sciences

title: Terrestrial Ecosystems and Climate Change
description: Controls on fluxes and stocks of nutrients within terrestrial ecosystems, ecosystem responses, feedbacks to climate change. Climate systems, water transport, production and decomposition, nutrient cycling, stable isotopes, spatial and temporal integration.

title: Advanced Topics in Environmental Science
description: Advanced special topics in environmental sciences.
